استؤنفت (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْنِفْتُ (ustuʔniftu) /us.tuʔ.nif.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
# اُسْتُؤْنِفْتَ (ustuʔnifta) /us.tuʔ.nif.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
# اُسْتُؤْنِفْتِ (ustuʔnifti) /us.tuʔ.nif.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
# اُسْتُؤْنِفَتْ (ustuʔnifat) /u
